summary: AnaptysBio, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing completion of the spin-off of First Tracks Biotherapeutics, Inc. on April 20, 2026. Under the separation, each AnaptysBio shareholder received one share of First Tracks common stock for each share held on the April 6 record date. The spin-off separates the royalty-management business (dostarlimab/Jemperli and imsidolimab royalties) from the biotechnology business. First Tracks began trading on Nasdaq under ticker 'TRAX' on the distribution date. The companies entered into a separation and distribution agreement and a transition services agreement to govern post-spin relationships. What to watch: any subsequent trading activity in First Tracks and whether the market assigns a higher combined value post-separation.
